VERDICT: ACCEPT_SOURCE_VERIFIED_PARTIAL_ANALOGUE_ONLY.

The DMS source identifies an abstract hypocoercive modified-energy mechanism
under H1--H4 and Theorem 2; the short quoted opening is faithful. The intake
does not attribute its own map to DMS or claim that DMS supplies the required
source fit.

For H=L2(eta), Pi=C and L=C-I,
  -Re <LG,G> = ||(I-C)G||^2
is exact because C is an orthogonal conditional-expectation projection. This
is only microscopic dissipation. It survives the Gaussian negative-V control,
so cannot discriminate the actual theta target. No skew transport, operator
domain, macroscopic coercivity, boundary treatment, or identity with the
actual signed V/micro term is constructed.

All three recorded shelf queries carry INCOMPLETE status from freshness
validation; the report correctly treats this as neither a no-hit nor an
absence result. The return to the separately specified K2 test is a bounded
planning statement, not a claimed result. No theta sign supplier, V witness,
or RH step is introduced.
